# file_picker

**Tag**: file-picker, files, storage, desktop, web

## 简介

A package that allows you to use a native file explorer to pick single or multiple absolute file paths, with extension filtering support.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/vicajilau/flutter_file_picker
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/vicajilau/flutter_file_picker/tree/main/packages/file_picker
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/vicajilau/flutter_file_picker/issues
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/file_picker
